capabilities: Turn notes tagged #decks into flashcards from headings, tables, cloze highlights, and image occlusion
Schedule reviews with FSRS-6 and train algorithm weights on your own review history
Run graded exam sessions with multiple-choice, type-in, and cloze questions
Import Anki .apkg collections and migrate cards from the Spaced Repetition plugin
Sync card state across devices via sync logs and a SQLite database, with optional AI card generation
extras: AI card generation is freemium via DecksMD Pro or your own API key; the ready-made deck directory requires a free DecksMD account; full documentation lives at decksmd.app; the engine is AGPL-3.0 licensed.
intentEvidence: Decks was built as an alternative for users who want a different architectural approach
motivation: The author built it as an alternative offering purely structural Markdown (no special syntax) and conflict-free syncing via a local SQLite database.
problem: Flashcards in Obsidian usually require special inline syntax or an external app like Anki; this plugin instead parses the note structure you already write, and carries review history across devices and from other tools.
